placements.title: Empirical Reference Verification Anchors Observational Readiness Across Active Bands
placements.frame: How do calibration baselines and reference standards establish and verify reliable instrument performance across full observing bands?
placements.why: The segments report the calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph at 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates across the full observing band, supporting the broader theme of validating observational instrument readiness through empirical reference comparisons.
